title: kit.projects.v1
description: The project registry: one entry per project, the single source of every project's name, domain and resource prefixes (docs/NAMING.md renders its table from it). The hardcoding scan reads it to recognise project names and URLs in package code.

key.description: Registry key = the full prefix without the dash.

short.description: Short resource prefix (null: none yet, unless shortPolicy says none by decision).

shortPolicy.description: The owner decided this project has NO short form, ever (the full name is the only prefix): `short` must then be null or absent, and docs/NAMING.md says "none, by decision" instead of "none yet", so a later short prefix cannot slip in.

aliases.description: Other spellings of the name the scan should recognise (e.g. with spaces).

github.description: The GitHub user who owns the project and is the sole approver of its ledgers: the default for `kit trust propose --owner` and the CODEOWNERS lines. The owner's name lives only in the owner-signed trust roster.

owner.description: The project owner (canonical source of the owner handle).

theme.description: The project's vendored diagram theme: a file under packages/core/registry/themes/, a byte copy of the project's own docs/diagrams/theme.init with its provenance in themes/sources.json (theme-sources.schema.json). A diagram whose header says this project is drawn in it, wherever it is rendered; a project without one has its diagrams refused outside its own repository.

github.description: The GitHub user who owns the project and is the sole approver of its ledgers: the default for `kit trust propose --owner` and the CODEOWNERS lines. The owner's name lives only in the owner-signed trust roster.

owner.description: The project owner (canonical source of the owner handle).

capabilityEngine.description: The kit capability engine serves this project: its capability registry entries carry ids <code>.capability.<domain>.<action> (finding class capability-id-prefix, whose pattern packages/core/scripts/project-codes.mjs generates from this flag). A project that builds its own engine leaves it out.

legacy.description: Retired prefixes: never used for new resources.
